name: panel
description: A box drawn with line characters and a title in its border, like the panels of btop. Place other widgets inside it.

config.name: title
config.label: Title
config.description: The title on the left side of the top border

config.name: title_right
config.label: Right Title
config.description: A second title on the right side of the top border

config.name: border_style
config.label: Border Style
config.description: The characters used for the border

config.name: font
config.label: Font
config.description: Use the same monospace font as the widgets inside the panel. Defaults to Cascadia Mono, Consolas or the system monospace font

config.name: background_color
config.label: Background
config.description: The background color of the panel
